propositions: GET-rotation stamps currently embedded in the large sort-ordered bindings.json must be moved to a dedicated sidecar file .bridge_state/get_rotation.json to reduce bindings.json bloat
During A2-1 compatibility phase, new binaries must write both the sidecar and legacy inline format, reading max(new, legacy) to ensure old binaries can observe progress made by new binaries

The extracted get_rotation.py module must handle load, canonicalize, compute effective max, dual-write, and atomic save operations as a cohesive seam without exceeding the 800-line policy for binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py
The sidecar file must be explicitly staged in git commits via reconcile_helpers.py and basename membership checks, not rely on git add -A, to support local reconciliation workflows
After mixed old-binary and new-binary pass sequences, rotation order must match the all-new sequence via max() semantics and dual-write consistency
reconcile-check runs with persist=False and must not create the sidecar file or modify git status for pre-migration stores
